To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a recalibration of MS spectra in a data self-recalibration (DASER) step and a subsequent mixture mass fingerprint (MMF) search can improve the performance of peptide identification from online LC-MS/MS analyses.
the DASER-MMF algorithm improves the protein identification ability of online LC-MS/MS data by recalibrating the data and then searching for proteins based on the recalibrated data.

a novel algorithm based on data self-recalibration followed by a mixture mass fingerprint search (DASer-MMF) has the ability to significantly improve protein identification from high-resolution mass spectrometer data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the improvement of protein identification from LC-MS/MS datasets.
the development and implementation of a novel algorithm for recalibration and protein identification from online LC-MS/MS data.
the development of a novel algorithm to improve the identification of proteins from online 1-D or 2-D LC-MS/MS data.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DASER-MMF search is a powerful tool for the identification of proteins from complex mixtures.
this algorithm is an important step in the development of an MS-based proteomics platform that can provide accurate and reliable protein identification within complex samples.

the DASER-MMF algorithm provides a significant improvement in protein identification ability, and that it is especially useful for the identification of new proteins and the enhancement of sequence coverage.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
DASER-MMF can be used to enhance protein identification in complex samples, but the degree to which this occurs depends on the quality of the data.
the MMF search is able to improve the performance in the protein identification of online LC-MS/MS data by 20% to 50%.

the DASER-MMF approach provides a significant improvement in protein identification ability, particularly with simple mixtures, and that further refinements are needed to improve performance with complex samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
high mass accuracy data can be utilized to identify proteins from complex mixtures with a simple and effective search algorithm.
the MMF search is able to identify proteins from a mixture of peptides that are not present in the original MS/MS based database search.
recalibration of the MS data is an effective method to improve MS/MS search algorithms and that recalibration of MS data is possible with high accuracy.
